profile.headline: Software Developer at Wolters Kluwer
profile.summary: Energetic determined engineer who enjoys solving problems, and working with others to deliver high quality products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-- Currently mange a multi-tenant .NET thick client with backend Oracle DB data store
-- Design, implement, maintain asp.net/mvc web applications and web apis
-- Design, implement asp.net web api
-- Optimize Oracle DB packages/stored procedures
-- Work with 3rd party software vendors and data providers 
-- Participate in all phases of the SDLC ( From Requirements gathering to Implementation )
-- Backlog management: Creating features and user stories, estimating and prioritizing the work
-- Scrum Master: Practice agile in all aspects of SDLC
-- Extremely familiar with all aspects of Azure DevOps (ADO) build pipelines and releases, variable management, server configuration, custom powershell scripting as needed
-- Security champion: Use proven tools such as Blackduck, Checkmarx, and SonarQube to identify security vulnerabilities, create work items on backlog and prioritize to resolve any issues
-- Integrate SonarQube into ADO CI/CD build pipeline to analyze code smells and reduce overall tech debt
-- Work with internal teams including infrastructure to coordinate changes that could have impact on internal services consumers

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
  -- Provide support for legacy based Delphi application. 
  -- Provide support for Asp.NET web application.
  -- Estimating backlog work items during sprint planning meeting. Accurately estimating scope of work prior to commitment meeting.
  -- Work independently with internal/external teams to complete work items. 
  -- Design, implement, test, and document if needed the newly implemented solution.
  -- Work closely with QA to ensure greater product test coverage.
  -- Collaborate with various internal teams as well as external third-party vendors.
  -- Work directly with project and product management when needed. 

Scrum Master duties: 
 -- Scheduling and leading sprint planning, commitment, demo, and retro meetings. 
 -- Scheduling and leading daily SCRUM meetings.
 -- Working with project team to ensure issues/impediments are resolved in a timely manner to ensure all committed work items are completed prior to the completion of the sprint duration.
 -- Document sprint artifacts.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Worked with project stakeholders and other teams to hash out requirement specifications for new product features for the TaxWise Desktop and TaxWise Online products.
Designed and executed black-box tests for TaxWise Desktop and TaxWise Online products.
Designed and executed white-box tests on a highly scalable large volume data center.  
Designed and developed automated tests for legacy functionality in the TaxWise Desktop product.

positions.title: Tech Support Representative
positions.description:
- Research, diagnose, troubleshoot and identify solutions to resolve customer issues
- Provide prompt and accurate feedback to customers
- Take ownership of customer issues reported and see problems through to resolution
- Document knowledge in the form of knowledge base tech notes and bugs
- Assist Quality assurance department with black box testing in off peak season.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Assist customers by providing information on products and services and making recommendations when needed.

positions.title: Assistant Store Manager
positions.description:
- Resolve customer and quality control issues.
- Manage active staff levels with respect to customer product demand.
- Running daily operation sales reports and reporting the results to corporate headquarters.
- Taking inventory and determining future stock level needs.
